bgLocation.title: Background Location Access
bgLocation.message:
Lokeye needs access to your location in the background so we can match you with nearby tasks even when the app is not open.

What we collect: your GPS location, updated roughly every minute.

This data is used only for task matching and is not shared for advertising or sold to third parties. You can disable this at any time in your device settings.
